title: {Syn} p-adic Numbers Measure Divisibility Instead of Size
content:
In the p-adic world, two numbers are close when their difference is divisible by a high power of the prime p. That makes 1 and 1 + 5^10 extremely close in the 5-adic metric.

This viewpoint looks strange at first, but it is central in modern number theory because it turns divisibility into geometry.

Why it matters: number theory keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
